title: SCA Minhag of the Week 292: "Megillah Readings At Home"

chapters.title: Purim and Megillat Esther
chapters.about: The story of Purim and praising God in public

chapters.title: Rav Avraham Antebi on Private Minyanim
chapters.about: Ohel Yesharim and people staying home from the synagogue

summary: Joseph Mosseri discusses Megillat Esther readings at home versus in the synagogue, referencing Rav Avraham Antebi's writings on public participation. He also reviews the different community customs regarding making berachot when reading the Megillah at home for women.
questions: Why is it important to read the Megillah in the synagogue rather than at home?
What did Rav Avraham Antebi write about people making private minyanim on Purim?
Does someone who already heard the Megillah in the bit keneset make berachot when reading for women at home?
What is the minhag of Aram Soba regarding berachot when reading the Megillah at home for ladies?
